```{r reference index}

# index with human & EBV genome
ref_genome <- file.path(data_dir, "ref_genome/hg38_NC007605_genome.fa")

```

```{r experiment design by treatment status}
logfc_limit <- 0.6
pvalue_limit <- 0.05


# COMPARING TREATMENT GROUPS WITHIN CELL LINE
cell_lines <- c('akata', 'cf5', 'lcl', 'ibl1', 'mutu')
treatment_comparisons <- c('2v1', '3v1', '3v2')


# edgeR to find DEGs
for (x in cell_lines){
  fit <- edger_fit_genes(x)
  for (y in treatment_comparisons){
    edger_degs(fit, x, y)
  }
}


# volcano plots
## can label viral genes using label = 'viral'
## or label custom gene list using label = 'custom' and gene = your_list
for (x in cell_lines){
  for (y in treatment_comparisons){
    degs_volcano_plot(x, y)
  }
}


# making venn diagrams to compare DEGs between cell lines
compare_cells <- c('akata', 'ibl1', 'lcl', 'mutu') # change for different comparisons
for (y in treatment_comparisons){
  degs_venn_diagram(compare_cells, y, 'up')
  degs_venn_diagram(compare_cells, y, 'down')
}


# pathway enrichment analysis bar plots using MSigDB
## can change collection & subcollection
## use msigdbr_collections() to view options
msigdb_pathway_enrichment_analysis('mutu', '2v1')
```

```{r getting DEGs for akata vs cf5}

counts <- read.csv(paste0(data_dir, '/exp_counts/counts_all.csv'))
counts <- counts[,1:25]
counts_dmso <- counts[,c(1:5,14:17)]
counts_ms177 <- counts[,c(1,6:9,18:21)]
counts_taz <- counts[,c(1,10:13,22:25)]


groups <- c(1,1,1,1,2,2,2,2)
dge <- DGEList(counts_taz, group = groups) # creating DGE list
keep <- filterByExpr(dge) #filtering out low counts
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
norm_counts <- normLibSizes(dge)


metadata <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, 'samples_2.csv'),
                           stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
design <- model.matrix( ~ cell_line, data = metadata)
rownames(design) <- colnames(norm_counts)
y <- estimateDisp(norm_counts, design, robust = TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design, robust = TRUE)

#cf5 vs akata
lrt <- glmLRT(fit, coef = 2)

## should put in condition so function stops here without valid comparison
df <- as.data.frame(lrt)

# converting ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbol
genes <- df$gene_id
annots <- select(org.Hs.eg.db,
                 keys = genes,
                 columns = "SYMBOL",
                 keytype = "ENSEMBL")

df <- merge(df, annots, by.x = "gene_id", by.y = "ENSEMBL")
df$SYMBOL <- ifelse(is.na(df$SYMBOL), df$gene_id, df$SYMBOL)

#removing genes with PValue = 0
df <- filter(df, PValue != 0)

# annotating DEGs as no/up/down regulated
df$diffexpressed <- "NO"
df$diffexpressed[df$logFC > logfc_limit &
                   df$PValue < pvalue_limit] <- "UP"
df$diffexpressed[df$logFC < -logfc_limit &
                   df$PValue < pvalue_limit] <- "DOWN"

treatment <- 'taz'

# saving DEG lists
## all DEGs
sorted_df <- df %>% arrange(PValue)
csv_file_path <- paste0(pipe_dir, '/degs/', treatment, "_cf5_vs_akata.csv")
write.csv(sorted_df, csv_file_path, row.names = FALSE)
## significant DEGs
sig_degs <- filter(sorted_df, diffexpressed != 'NO')
sig_path <- paste0(pipe_dir, '/degs/', treatment, "_cf5_vs_akata_sig.csv")
write.csv(sig_degs, sig_path, row.names = FALSE)
## significant up regulated DEGs
up_degs <- filter(sorted_df, diffexpressed == 'UP')
up_path <- paste0(pipe_dir, '/degs/', treatment, "_cf5_vs_akata_sig_up.csv")
write.csv(up_degs, up_path, row.names = FALSE)
## significant down regulated DEGs
down_degs <- filter(sorted_df, diffexpressed == 'DOWN')
down_path <- paste0(pipe_dir, '/degs/', treatment, "_cf5_vs_akata_sig_down.csv")
write.csv(down_degs, down_path, row.names = FALSE)



```

```{r experiment design by cell line}
# COMPARING CELL LINES WITHIN TREATMENT GROUPS
treatments <- c('dmso', 'ms177', 'taz')
cells_group <- 'cf5_vs_akata'


# volcano plots
for (x in treatments){
  degs_volcano_plot(x, cells_group)
}


# making venn diagrams to compare DEGs between treatment groups
treatment_compare <- c('ms177', 'taz')

degs_venn_diagram(treatment_compare, cells_group, 'up')
degs_venn_diagram(treatment_compare, cells_group, 'down')


# MSigDB PEA
msigdb_pathway_enrichment_analysis('ms177', cells_group)
```
